Set this or absorption_coeff; a config layer that sets one empties the other (Heat deposition). Default for every tissue. [0–1]; source: Pinton et al., 2012 absorption_coeff Absorption coefficient, with the power law alpha_power; empty by default. Set this or absorption_fraction. dB/cm/MHz; source: Pinton et al., 2012

items.title: Placement and Time Reversal Parameters
items.text:
These parameters set how the transducer is placed on the head, per placement mode, and the time-reversal refocusing and pose search.

On this page:

  • Transducer Placement (placement): placement mode, skin gap, reuse, and the per-mode keys.
  • Time Reversal (time_reversal): the extra point-source run per target.

items.title: Transducer Placement (placement)
items.text:
See Transducer Placement.

Parameter Description Default Comments mode Placement mode. 'manual' 'manual', 'localite', 'heuristic', 'mni', 'plantus', or 'tus_entry'. report Write the stand-alone placement report sub-XXX_placement_<mode>.html to io.dir_reports. true See placement report. export_formats Also write the placed poses for other tools, to io.dir_output. [] Any of 'brainsight', 'slicer', 'kplan'. See Exporting a pose. skin_gap_mm Gap between scalp and transducer exit plane along the beam axis [mm]. 5 e.g. a gel pad. Used by heuristic, MNI, PlanTUS, and TUS_entry placement and by their time-reversal pose search; manual and Localite poses keep their own gap. The exit plane lies curv_radius_mm − dist_geom_ep_mm in front of the bowl apex. reuse When to reuse a recorded heuristic, PlanTUS, or TUS_entry run (placement_run.json in its run folder). 'auto' 'auto': reuse it when its settings match, else run again; 'always': require it (mismatch per io.cache_signature_check); 'never': always run. Independent of io.overwrite_files. See Starting from earlier stage outputs.

items.title: Manual Placement (placement.manual)
items.text:
See Manual placement.

Parameter Description Default Comments coordinate_space Space of transducer.trans_pos / focus_pos in mode='manual'. 'voxel' 'voxel' (1-based T1 voxels), 'ras' (subject RAS+ mm), 'mni' (MNI mm; both via charm's nonlinear warp, no scalp snapping). Converted per transducer in the placement stage, which must be enabled.

items.title: Localite Placement (placement.localite)
items.text:
See Neuronavigation Read-In.

Parameter Description Default Comments enabled Load transducer position from Localite neuronavigation files in head preprocessing? 0 1 = yes, 0 = no. Older switch; placement.mode: 'localite' is the placement-stage equivalent. Both use neuronav_localite_pose. file Single Localite XML (TriggerMarkers, GUMMarkers, or InstrumentMarker; type detected). '' File mode. Empty = automatic mode (ingested markers under path.localite_post). session Session of the automatic mode. 1 Integer n → ses-0n, or 'ses-XX'. target Select the series by name. '' Ingested target name (automatic mode) or entry description (file mode). Several transducers: one name per transducer, e.g. [L_M1, R_M1] (transducer i uses entry i); a single name applies to all. position Otherwise: index of the detected series (1-based, after the expected_segment_length filter). 1 Automatic mode matches it against series_index in the JSON sidecar. Several transducers: one index per transducer, e.g. [1, 2]. markertype Deprecated, ignored. 'TriggerMarkers' The marker type is detected from the files. loc_folder Folder between ses-XX/ and the Localite export. 'loc' '' = the export sits directly under ses-XX/. session_folder_pattern Wildcard that a folder between loc_folder and the marker files must match. '*' e.g. 'Session_2024*'. expected_segment_length Pulses per TriggerMarkers series. 80 Series off by more than 20 pulses are dropped; [] keeps all. voxel_size Voxel size for position_dev_vox in the series statistics [mm]. 0.9 Does not affect positions. reference_distance_mm Fallback offset from the Localite matrix origin to the bowl rear centre, along the beam axis [mm]. 15 Used only when tracker_to_bowl_mm is empty and the transducer has no scalar curv_radius_mm and dist_geom_ep_mm. Same sign convention as tracker_to_bowl_mm. tracker_to_bowl_mm Measured offset from the Localite matrix origin to the bowl rear centre [mm]. [] Overrides geometry and reference_distance_mm.

items.title: Neuronavigation Ingestion (neuronav)
items.text:
See Localite ingestion; coil_map also feeds target resolution.

Parameter Description Default Comments coil_map Multi-coil ingestion: one entry per coil with .coil (index of TriggerMarkers_Coil<N>) and .target or .sequences(:).target. [] [] = single-coil ingestion (Coil0, GUMMarkers fallback). suggest_names Name series after the planned target nearest their beam axis. true See naming. axis_tolerance_mm Max. distance of that target from the beam axis [mm]. 10 target_depth_mm Accepted target depth along the beam axis [mm]. [0, 150] Narrow around the focal distance to reject far matches. target_labels Label map: entries .target + .labels (patterns with */?, case-insensitive). [] [] = labels used as recorded; list them with neuronav_scan_sessions. batch_write Series written by neuronav_ingest_batch: 'all' tracked series or only 'named' ones. 'all'

items.title: Heuristic Placement (placement.heuristic)
items.text:
See Heuristic Transducer Placement.

Parameter Description Default Comments save_localite_t1 Save Localite-aligned T1 output for header correction? false See Heuristic Transducer Placement. dist_close Distance from target considered sufficiently close [mm]. [] ear_radius Radius of the ear exclusion zone [mm]. 35 left_ear_center Approximate coordinates for left ear [image voxels]. [] Optional right_ear_center Approximate coordinates for right ear [image voxels]. [] Optional criterion_intersection Max fraction of exit plane intersecting the skull. 0.05 Reduces skull traversal. Expanded by expand_step up to 0.3 when no candidate meets it. criterion_skin_mean Mean distance of EP voxels from skin [quantile]. [] Favours a short exit-plane distance to the skin. [] = off. criterion_skull_mean Mean distance of EP voxels from skull [quantile]. [] Favours a short exit-plane distance to the skull. [] = off. criterion_skin_var Variance of EP voxel distance from skin [quantile]. [] Favours an exit plane parallel to the skin (little curvature). [] = off. criterion_skull_var Variance of EP voxel distance from skull [quantile]. [] Favours an exit plane parallel to the skull (irregular bone distorts the wavefront). [] = off. expand_step Expansion step for skin intersection criterion. 0.01 1% candidate Candidate to place instead of the heuristic's choice. [] idx in tpars_sub-XXX_<target>.csv of the last run; the criteria are not applied. Set by Place here on the Nexus Heuristic page. See position selection.

items.title: MNI Placement (placement.mni)
items.text:
See MNI Transducer Placement.

Parameter Description Default Comments trans_pos_mm Desired transducer (scalp entry) position [MNI mm]. [] Required for mode='mni'. Converted with charm's nonlinear warp, then snapped to the scalp. focus_pos_mm Focus / target position [MNI mm]. [] Required for mode='mni'. Converted with the nonlinear (nonl) transform, like the heuristic target.

items.title: PlanTUS Placement (placement.plantus)
items.text:
See PlanTUS Placement.

Headless or interactive selection is set by interactive, which defaults to simulation.interactive.

Parameter Description Default Comments script_path PlanTUS installation directory (contains code/PlanTUS.py). '' Required. env_path SimNIBS installation or conda env whose Python runs PlanTUS. '' '' = the Python of the SimNIBS install in startup.simnibs_bin_path. target_name Target label, used in output folder and file names. '' Required. Outputs go to <path.placement>/sub-XXX/plantus/<target_name>/. mni_target_mm Target [MNI mm]. [] Empty = use transducer.focus_pos (voxels). focal_distance_list Focal distances from the calibration [mm]. [] Required. Set the eligible and optimal skin–target distance. flhm_list Focal length at half maximum per entry of focal_distance_list [mm]. [] Required. max_angle_deg Maximum transducer tilt [deg]. 10 mask_radius_mm Radius of the spherical target mask [mm]. 2 skin_smoothing_iterations Taubin smoothing passes on the skin surface before the criteria are computed. 2 0 = raw SimNIBS surface. min_distance_mm Smallest eligible skin–target distance [mm]. [] [] = min(focal_distance_list) − max(flhm_list). For a steerable array, set it and max_distance_mm to the steering range; the default margin otherwise admits spots the focus cannot reach. max_distance_mm Largest eligible skin–target distance [mm]. [] [] = max(focal_distance_list) + max(flhm_list). optimal_distance_mm Optimum of the distance criterion [mm]. [] [] = mean(focal_distance_list). weight_skin_target_distances Weight: deviation of skin–target distance from the optimal distance. 0.2 The five weights should sum to 1. See composite scoring. weight_skin_target_angles Weight: angle between skin normal and direction to target. 0.2 weight_skin_target_intersections Weight: beam path length inside the target (higher is better). 0.2 weight_skin_skull_angles Weight: angle between skin and skull normals. 0.2 weight_skull_thickness Weight: bone path length along the skin normal. 0.2 From m2m_sub-XXX/final_tissues.nii.gz; ignored if that file is missing. See skull thickness. save_metrics Write per-vertex criteria, score, and selected vertex to plantus_metrics.mat. true Both modes. Used by the criteria evaluation and offline re-scoring. evaluate Evaluate the placement from plantus_metrics.mat (weight sweep, diagnostics, figures). true Both modes; needs save_metrics. Shown in the placement report. See criteria evaluation. interactive Choose the vertex in Connectome Workbench. [] 1 = interactive, 0 = headless, [] = follow simulation.interactive. 1 needs a display but not the MATLAB desktop; without a display PlanTUS runs headless. vertex Skin vertex (0-based) to place on the maps of an earlier run, without recomputing them. [] Set by Place here on the Nexus PlanTUS page. [] = compute the maps and place the optimum (or the Workbench pick). Stops if the target moved since the maps were computed. See choosing the position. connectome_wb_path Connectome Workbench bin/ directory. '' Needed for interactive: 1 (wb_view), unless it is on PATH or in the env's bin/.

items.title: TUS_entry Placement (placement.tus_entry)
items.text:
See TUS_entry placement.

Not in config_default.yaml; the keys are listed in nexus/prestus_nexus/overlay.yaml.

Parameter Description Default Comments script_path Full path to TUS_entry.R. none Required. env_path Conda environment containing Rscript. none Required. scalp_mask Head or scalp mask in the T1 grid (nonzero = head). SimNIBS final_tissues.nii.gz Filled into a solid head mask in the work directory. target_mask Binary NIfTI target mask. (auto) Empty: a sphere around focus_pos or mni_target_mm. target_mask_radius_mm Radius of the auto-generated target sphere [mm]. 5 mni_target_mm Target [MNI mm]. (from focus_pos) Converted to subject space with SimNIBS. exclu_mask Binary NIfTI exclusion zone (e.g. ventricles, vessels). '' minimal_distance_cm Minimum scalp-to-target depth [cm]. 4.24 maximal_distance_cm Maximum scalp-to-target depth [cm]. 7.46 transducer_size_cm Transducer outer diameter [cm]. 6.4 voxel_size_cm Voxel size [cm]. (T1 voxel size) Default: the mean T1 voxel size (the masks are on the T1 grid). TUS_entry assumes isotropic voxels. resolution_cm Spatial decimation step [cm]. 0.33 return_candidates Save the ranked candidate list as RDS. false target_name Label for output folder and file names. 'target' work_dir Output directory override. (auto) Default <path.placement>/sub-XXX/tus_entry/<target_name>/.

items.title: Time Reversal (time_reversal)
items.text:
See Time reversal.

One extra k-Wave run per target (point source at the target), between the free-water baseline and the acoustic simulation.

Parameter Description Default Comments enabled Run the reverse simulation and write the refocusing / aberration report. false Cartesian 2D/3D grids with the k-Wave source setup; not with acoustic_backend: babelbrain (use babelbrain.do_refocusing). apply_phases Use the time-reversal phases in the acoustic run. false Matrix: per element; annular: per ring; ignored for a single element. ISPPA targeting keeps the drive amplitudes of the geometric drive. save_field Save the complex reverse field (sensor region) with the results. false <dir_cache>/<prefix>_timereversal.mat. placement_search.enabled Score transducer poses around the planned one on the same reverse run. false Curved annular transducers, 3D. Suggestions only: the acoustic run keeps the planned pose. placement_search.max_angle_deg Largest tilt of the beam direction from the planned one [deg]. 20 Poses lie on an orbit around the target, against the scalp. placement_search.angle_step_deg Angular step of the candidate directions [deg]. 2.5 placement_search.aim_iterations Re-aim at target − predicted shift this many times. 2 0 = geometric aim only. placement_search.jitter_mm Also score the planned pose with its apex moved by these distances [mm], aimed at the target. [] One or more, e.g. 0.5 (the local search users often run with forward simulations) or [0.5 1 2 5]. Rows of kind jitter, distance in column jitter_mm. placement_search.jitter_mode How jitter_mm moves the apex. 'grid' 'grid': ± along each grid axis, as when editing voxel coordinates (6 poses per distance; the bowl is not re-seated, so beyond ~1 mm it can cut into or lift off the scalp). 'scalp': slid over the scalp perpendicular to the planned beam in 8 directions and re-seated against the scalp (8 poses per distance). only Stop after the time-reversal stage. false No water baseline, acoustic, or thermal simulation: the report and pose table only. pose_workflow.enabled Run the pose workflow (search → forward verification → final full-grid run) instead of a single simulation. false One curved annular transducer, simulation.medium: layered. See Pose workflow. pose_workflow.n_top Number of best poses (by predicted target pressure after aim correction) to verify. 5 The planned pose is always verified as the reference. pose_workflow.poses Pose ids of the pose table to verify as well. [] pose_workflow.aim Aim of the verification runs. 'corrected' 'corrected' (aberration-corrected aim point), 'geometric' (at the target) or 'both'. pose_workflow.verify_fov Grid of the verification runs. 'partial' 'partial': acoustic FOV around each beam (grid.acoustic_fov_*, 'auto' unless set); 'full'; 'config': as configured. pose_workflow.target_radius_mm Radius of the target sphere over which the simulated intensity is averaged [mm]. 2 pose_workflow.rank_by How the best pose is chosen. 'target_intensity' 'target_intensity' (highest mean intensity in the target sphere) or 'focus_error' (smallest distance from the −3 dB focal centroid to the target). pose_workflow.max_focus_error_mm Only poses whose −3 dB focal centroid lies within this distance of the target qualify [mm]. [] [] = no limit. pose_workflow.final_run Run the best pose on the full grid with the configured modules. true Affix <affix>_posebest. pose_workflow.search_memorylimit hpc.memorylimit of the search run [GB]. [] [] = hpc.memorylimit. The search records the field over all candidate poses.

items.title: Run, Paths, and Outputs Parameters
items.text:
These parameters say which subject runs where, which files it reads and writes, which pipeline stages run, and how cluster jobs are sized.

On this page:

  • Subject and Platform (subject_id, platform): subject identifier and execution platform.
  • Data Paths (path): input, segmentation, simulation, and Localite folders.
  • Environment & Toolbox Paths (startup): SimNIBS, MATLAB and other external tool paths.
  • I/O Management (io): output affix, overwriting, cache checks, and which matrices are saved.
  • Pipeline Modules (modules): which pipeline stages run.
  • Report (report): the HTML reports a run writes.
  • Study Setup (study): study manifest and output folder name.
  • High-Performance Computing (hpc): GPU, partition, time and memory limits for cluster jobs.

items.title: Subject and Platform (subject_id, platform)
items.text: Parameter Description Default Comments subject_id Subject identifier used for file naming and folder management. 0 Placeholder; must be set before calling prestus_pipeline_start(parameters). platform Execution platform. 'auto' auto / slurm / qsub / matlab. auto detects SLURM or qsub and errors when neither is installed; use matlab to run in the current session. See HPC.

items.title: Data Paths (path)
items.text:
Give file and folder settings as absolute paths. A relative path in these settings, and in the other file and folder settings of a run, is taken from the PRESTUS folder; the *_pattern settings are relative to path.anat.

Parameter Description Default Comments anat Absolute path to structural input data. none Mandatory sim Absolute path to simulation outputs. none Mandatory seg Absolute path to SimNIBS segmentations (m2m folders). none Mandatory placement Placement outputs: one folder per run, <placement>/sub-XXX/<mode>/<target_name>/ (heuristic, PlanTUS, TUS_entry). '' Empty = <sim>/placement. Share one folder across setups to reuse placements. See Where outputs live. localite_raw Raw Localite exports, <localite_raw>/sub-XXX/ses-XX/[<loc_folder>/]…. '' See Localite I/O. localite_post Ingested Localite markers, <localite_post>/sub-XXX/ses-XX/InstrumentMarker_sub-XXX_ses-XX.xml/.json. '' Written by neuronav_ingest_markers / neuronav_gui; read by placement.mode: 'localite' (automatic mode). localite_t1 Folder with the planning T1s loaded into Localite ([sub-XXX/]<localite_t1_pattern>). '' Empty = localite_raw. localite_t1_pattern File-name template of the planning T1; %s = sub-XXX. '%s_*T1*.nii*' Replaces neuronav_t1_pattern (still read). localite_export Output folder for files to import into Localite (heuristic placement), per subject sub-XXX/. '' Resolved into io.dir_localite_export. transducer_library Your own transducer library for every study of this project: equipment entries (*_transducer.yaml, *_driver.yaml), calibration entries, and profiles/. '' A folder or a list of folders. Set it in the project copy of config_default.yaml. Checked after transducer.library_path and before the PRESTUS_TRANSDUCER_LIBRARY environment variable and the shipped library. See Your own transducers and calibrations. pct Pseudo-CT outputs, per subject <pct>/sub-NNN/. '' Empty = <parent of path.seg>/pct/sub-NNN/, next to the SimNIBS folder (never inside it). Resolved into io.dir_pct. acoustic_input Start from a prior pressure map instead of simulating: a peak-pressure NIfTI [Pa] in this subject's T1w space, e.g. an earlier run's nii/*_T1w*_pressure.nii.gz. '' Its JSON sidecar is checked against the current settings and used to rescale the map to transducer.target_isppa_wcm2; acoustic analysis and thermal simulation then run as usual. Replaces io.external_acoustic_nifti (still read). See Starting from earlier stage outputs. localite Deprecated. '' Read as localite_raw and as localite_export when those are empty. t1_pattern T1 image path template relative to path.anat. 'sub-%1$03d_T1w.nii*' Supports %03d-style subject ID substitution t2_pattern T2 image path template relative to path.anat. '' Optional; empty skips the T2 (e.g. 'sub-%1$03d_T2w.nii*'). ct_pattern Measured CT path template relative to path.anat, read by the skull mapping when pct.enabled is 1. '' In Hounsfield units and co-registered to the T1w. Empty = the pseudo-CT generated from the UTE image in t2_pattern. See Using a Measured CT. bone_mask_pattern Bone mask file for pct.bone_source: mask, relative to path.anat unless absolute. '' Nonzero voxels are bone; co-registered to the T1w, any voxel grid. See Skull from the CT.

items.title: Environment & Toolbox Paths (startup)
items.text:
Segmentation and MNI conversion need startup.simnibs_bin_path. The other paths are needed for pseudo-CT generation or to add folders to the MATLAB path.

Parameter Description Comments simnibs_bin_path Absolute path to the bin folder of a SimNIBS 4 install (holds charm). Mandatory for segmentation and MNI conversion. Selects the SimNIBS version. matlab_bin_path Absolute path to MATLAB binary. Required for pseudo-CT generation on HPC (e.g. /opt/matlab/R2024a/bin/matlab). Local execution falls back to matlabroot. fsl_bin_path Absolute path to FSL bin directory. Required for pseudo-CT generation (e.g. /opt/fsl/bin). Prepended to PATH at runtime. ants_bin_path Absolute path to ANTs bin directory. Required for pseudo-CT generation (e.g. /opt/ants/bin). Prepended to PATH at runtime. ants_simg_path ANTs Singularity image (.simg/.sif). When set, ANTs tools run via singularity exec. modules_to_load HPC environment modules loaded before pseudo-CT generation. e.g. ['matlab/R2023b', 'fsl/6.0.7', 'ants/2.5.3'] paths_to_add Paths to add with addpath(). [cell] e.g. {"path/to/x"} subpaths_to_add Paths to add recursively with addpath(genpath()). [cell]; relative to the MATLAB working directory

items.title: I/O Management (io)
items.text:
Parameter Description Default Comments output_affix Optional affix for output file names. '' Differentiates outputs for the same subject/transducer (e.g. different intensities or targets) overwrite_files File overwrite behaviour. 'always' never / always / force / ask. Does NOT apply to SimNIBS segmentations. In chained pipelines (async, multi-ISPPA, uncertainty), always re-runs only the output stages (CSV, NIfTI, HTML report) and reuses cached intermediates; force re-runs every stage. See Overwrite behaviour. cache_signature_check Response when a reused grid, medium, or acoustic cache, or a stage output a run starts from (placement run, pseudo-CT, pressure map), was built from different settings. 'error' error / warn (reuse anyway) / off. Caches: applies when one is reused because of overwrite_files: never (or a declined overwrite). See Cache reuse checks and Starting from earlier stage outputs. acoustic_cache_remap What a run does with a reused acoustic cache written on a different grid (e.g. the head model changed in between). 0 0: re-simulate, or stop when the run sets up no source; 1: map the field onto this grid through world space (pressures resampled as p²) and record the mapping in the acoustic provenance. 3-D runs only. See Cache reuse checks. overwrite_simnibs Overwrite SimNIBS segmentation results? 0 1 = yes, 0 = no. Re-runs charm (--forcerun), which deletes the m2m folder first. Without it, an existing segmentation is reused even when another SimNIBS version or other charm settings are selected (with a warning). save_matrices Save all intermediate matrices (.mat / cache files)? [] 1 = save all, 0 = save none, [] = use the per-step defaults. Applies to every per-step matrix flag left empty; a per-step flag set to 0/1 always wins. 0 also triggers cleanup of uncertainty intermediates. save_source_matrices Save kwave_source.mat (transducer source array)? [] → 1 [] inherits save_matrices, else default. Needed by multi-stage pipelines (e.g. uncertainty). save_acoustic_matrices Save acoustic results (sensor_data, kgrid, medium; can be very large)? [] → 0 [] inherits save_matrices, else default. Needed to reload acoustics (e.g. separate thermal runs, calibration debugging). save_thermal_matrices Save heating_res.mat (temperature time series and field maps)? [] → 1 [] inherits save_matrices, else default. save_grid_cache / save_medium_cache Save grid / medium caches? unset → 0 Inherit save_matrices when unset. save_property_maps Save per-property NIfTIs to nii/properties/ (layered medium only)? 0 Not affected by save_matrices. save_transducer_nii Save a model of the planned transducer as a T1-space NIfTI (nii/sub-XXX_<medium>_T1w<affix>_transducer.nii.gz)? 1 Layered medium, annular transducers. Voxel values: 1 = emitting face (smallest elem_id_mm to largest elem_od_mm), 0.5 = the thickness behind it (transducer_nii_back_mm), 0 = elsewhere, including the central opening. Built from the planned T1-voxel positions, on the T1 voxel grid, for placement checks next to the T1 and the acoustic maps. No MNI copy. Not affected by save_matrices. See NIfTI Images. transducer_nii_back_mm Thickness added behind the emitting face in the transducer NIfTI [mm]. 3 Display only, value 0.5: the emitting face (value 1) stays where PRESTUS places it. 0 gives the face alone. save_MNI Save NIfTI outputs in MNI space in addition to native T1w space (requires SimNIBS m2m folder)? 1 Not affected by save_matrices. save_heatingvideo Save a video of incremental heating? 0 1 = yes, 0 = no save_Ipa Save the pulse-average intensity (Ipa) NIfTI map? 1 Suppressed automatically when timing.pd is absent. save_Ita Save the temporal-average intensity (Ita) NIfTI map? 1 Suppressed automatically when timing.pd/timing.pri are absent. save_p_complex Save the complex pressure field (p_complex) in the acoustic cache? 0 Experimental for superposition. Every backend. k-Wave only: fitted over the last quarter period, and p_max_all/p_min_all become ± the fitted amplitude (Complex Pressure Field). deface_plots Remove facial anatomy from all QC figures? 1 1 = yes, 0 = no. Uses the SimNIBS eye label to anchor the cut plane ~30 mm posterior to the eye socket (ear-canal level). Requires the SimNIBS segmentation (path.seg). Has no effect on saved NIfTIs; see segmentation.deface for that. adopted_heatmap Path to an existing temperature heatmap NIfTI (heating_end.nii.gz) to use as the thermal starting point for a follow-up simulation. Set automatically by the sequential dispatcher; can be overridden manually. none Optional. Used for sequential multi-target runs. adopted_cem43 Path to an existing CEM43 heatmap NIfTI to accumulate heating across runs. Set automatically by the sequential dispatcher. none Optional. Used for sequential multi-target runs. adopted_cem43_iso Path to an existing ISO-variant CEM43 heatmap NIfTI (CEM43_iso_end.nii.gz) to accumulate across runs. Set automatically alongside adopted_cem43 by the sequential dispatcher. none Optional. Used for sequential multi-target runs.

Runtime-derived (set by path_log_setup):

Field Description dir_output Resolved per-subject output directory. Set from path.sim (+ subject subfolder). dir_nii NIfTI output subfolder (nii/). Created automatically. dir_nii_T1w Alias for dir_nii; space encoded in filename. dir_nii_MNI Alias for dir_nii; space encoded in filename. dir_img Image/figure output subfolder (img/). Used for all acoustic, thermal, and preprocessing figures. Created automatically. dir_tabular Directory for per-subject CSV results tables (same as dir_output). dir_reports Directory for simulation reports (same as dir_output). dir_logs Log subfolder (log/). Created automatically. dir_cache Cache subfolder (cache/). Created automatically. dir_debug Debug subfolder (debug/). Created when simulation.debug = 1. dir_debug_preproc Debug subfolder for preprocessing (debug/preproc/). dir_debug_medium Debug subfolder for medium setup (debug/medium/). dir_debug_source Debug subfolder for source setup (debug/source/). dir_pct Resolved subject pCT directory (get_pct_dir): <path.pct>/sub-NNN, or <parent of path.seg>/pct/sub-NNN. dir_localite_export Per-subject Localite export folder (<path.localite_export>/sub-XXX/, fallback path.localite); '' if unset. filename_table Path to the per-subject CSV results table. filename_kwave_source Path to cached k-Wave source .mat file. Set by source_sensor_setup.

items.title: Pipeline Modules (modules)
items.text:
Parameter Description Default Comments run_transducer_placement Resolve trans_pos/focus_pos from placement.mode. 1 Required when placement.manual.coordinate_space is ras or mni (positions are converted here). run_grid_setup Setup grid and run head processing. 1 Mandatory for simulations. run_medium_setup Map medium acoustic properties. 1 Mandatory for simulations. run_source_setup Set up acoustic source. 1 Mandatory for simulations. run_water_baseline Run a free-water simulation that records the ISPPA of the current drive, for scaling to transducer.target_isppa_wcm2. 'auto' auto: when a target is set and the transducer has no calibration ISPPA or the target differs from it. 1: always. 0: only when the target differs from a calibration ISPPA. A target that cannot be met stops the run (prestus:isppa:noBaseline). See ISPPA targeting. run_acoustic_sims Run acoustic simulations. 1 run_acoustic_analysis Run acoustic analysis. 1 run_heating_sims Run thermal simulations. 0 Enable after acoustic results are validated. run_thermal_analysis Run thermal analysis. 1 run_nifti_creation Export results as NIfTI files. 1 run_posthoc_water_sims Run free-water reference simulations after head simulations. 1 generate_report Generate self-contained HTML simulation report. 1 run_targeting_analysis Measure targeting accuracy from the focal-mask NIfTIs: simulated focus vs planned focus (native), vs MNI target / ROI (MNI). Writes sub-XXX_<medium><affix>_targeting.csv. 1 Layered or phantom media; needs run_nifti_creation. See Targeting accuracy. generate_group_report Aggregate completed subjects into a group HTML report at the end of the run. 1 Best-effort; auto-discovers subjects. Or run prestus_group_report_start manually. Switched off for runs started by prestus_study_start, which builds one study report at the end. segmentation_only Stop after segmentation; skip grid setup and all simulations. 0 Stops after the segmentation stage for every medium; only layered media are segmented, so water and phantom runs compute nothing.

All flags: 1 = yes, 0 = no.

items.title: Report (report)
items.text:
Whether the simulation report is written is set by modules.generate_report; style and style_switcher change only how the reports look.

Parameter Description Default Comments style Visual skin of the HTML report: instrument, classic (flat cards), compact, paper. Changes presentation only, not content. 'instrument' Try skins on an existing output folder with preview_report_styles(<subject dir>). style_switcher Embed all skins plus a dropdown to switch between them in the report. 0 segmentation Write the segmentation report sub-XXX_layered_segmentation_report<affix>.html. 1 Layered media. Shows each step from the SimNIBS segmentation to the simulation medium. debug Write the debug report sub-XXX_<medium>_debug_report<affix>.html. 1 Only with simulation.debug: 1. Also written when the run fails.

items.title: Study Setup (study)
items.text:
Multi-subject studies with per-run settings; see Group analysis.

Parameter Description Default Comments manifest Study manifest (.tsv/.csv): one row per run (subject_id, optional condition, include, config) plus any config key as a column. '' Relative paths resolve against the study config's folder. Run with prestus_study_start(<config>); report with prestus_group_report_start(<config>). name Name of the study outputs folder <path.sim>/group/<name>/. '' '' = manifest file name without extension.

items.title: High-Performance Computing (hpc)
items.text:
See k-Wave and HPC.

Parameter Description Default Comments gpu Request a specific GPU. '' e.g. "nvidia_a100-sxm4-40gb:1"; usually not needed. scontrol show nodes \| egrep -o gres/gpu:.*=[0-9] \| egrep -o 'nvidia_.*=' \| sort \| uniq \| sed 's/=//' lists the available types. See GPU support. partition Request a dedicated queue partition. '' reservation Request a reserved queue. '' name Cluster presets. 'default' 'snellius' selects the Snellius partition presets (snellius.*, below). exclude Nodes to avoid, comma-separated (SLURM sbatch --exclude). '' e.g. a node whose GPU is held by a stale process. cores CPU cores per job (SLURM --cpus-per-task). [] [] = cluster default (often 1). The k-Wave CPU builds (cpp_cpu, matlab_cpu) use this many threads. Set by the presets with hpc.name: 'snellius'. wait_for_job Block MATLAB until the submitted HPC job completes? false timelimit Job time limit. '04:00:00' memorylimit Memory limit [GB]. 20 posthoc_water_timelimit Time limit of the post-hoc free-water jobs (modules.run_posthoc_water_sims). '05:00:00' posthoc_water_memorylimit Memory limit of the post-hoc free-water jobs [GB]. 40 ld_library_path Prefixed to LD_LIBRARY_PATH for SimNIBS tools (charm, MNI conversion). '' '' = the libraries of the install in startup.simnibs_bin_path (<simnibs package>/external/lib/linux), so it follows the selected environment. Set only to override, e.g. /opt/gcc/7.2.0/lib64 for undefined symbol errors. The pseudo-CT job uses only a set value. job_prefix Prefix string for HPC job names. 'PS' Keep short; the job name is capped at 20 characters. Overridden to 'TP' for transducer positioning jobs. max_wait_checks Maximum number of job status checks when wait_for_job = true. 540 At 1 check/20 s, 540 ≈ 3 hours. tmp_gb Node-local disk per SLURM job [GB] (sbatch --tmp). 0 0 = off. With a value, the k-Wave C++ .h5 files go to scratch_dir inside the job (Node-local scratch). scratch_dir Scratch root used with tmp_gb > 0. 'auto' 'auto' = first existing of $PRESTUS_SCRATCH, $SLURM_TMPDIR, /scratch/$USER/$SLURM_JOB_NAME, /scratch/$USER/$SLURM_JOB_ID (else created under /scratch/$USER), then $TMPDIR. Or a path; $VAR is expanded and the folder created. depend_type Scheduler dependency type for depend_job_id(s). 'afterok' 'afterok' or 'afterany'. Internal (not in config_default.yaml); prestus_study_start uses 'afterany' for the study-report job.

items.title: Snellius GPU Partitions (snellius)
items.text:
Used when hpc.name: 'snellius': hpc.partition selects one of these blocks, which sets the job's resources.

Parameter Description Default Comments gpu_a100.cores CPU cores requested on gpu_a100. 18 gpu_a100.memorylimit Memory [GB] on gpu_a100. 120 gpu_a100.timelimit Wall time on gpu_a100. '120:00:00' Partition maximum. gpu_a100.n_gpu GPUs requested on gpu_a100. 1 gpu_h100.cores CPU cores requested on gpu_h100. 16 gpu_h100.memorylimit Memory [GB] on gpu_h100. 180 gpu_h100.timelimit Wall time on gpu_h100. '120:00:00' Partition maximum. gpu_h100.n_gpu GPUs requested on gpu_h100. 1

items.title: Simulation and Sonication Parameters
items.text:
These parameters choose the medium type and solvers, the sonication timing, the thermal model, and the output analysis.

On this page:

  • Simulation Type (simulation): medium, k-Wave code type, precision, interactive mode, live view, debug mode, transducer coupling.
  • Simulation Backends (acoustic_backend, thermal_backend): which solver runs the acoustic and thermal steps, and its settings.
  • Sonication Timing (timing): pulse and pulse-train durations and repetition intervals.
  • Thermal Settings (thermal): CEM43 variant, baseline temperatures, and thermal sensor and logging.
  • Output Analysis (analysis): focus-area radius and MNI target or ROI for analysis.

items.title: Simulation Type (simulation)
items.text: Parameter Description Default Comments medium Simulation medium type. 'layered' water / layered / phantom. Mandatory. code_type k-Wave backend. 'matlab_gpu' matlab_cpu / matlab_gpu / cpp_cpu / cpp_gpu / cpp_mlx. See k-Wave. precision Computational precision for acoustic and thermal simulations. 'single' single / double interactive Interactive mode with prompts and evolving plots. 0 1 = yes, 0 = no. If 0, see overwrite_files. live_view Plot the evolving pressure and temperature fields without prompts, also in batch and cluster runs, and save them every 5 s in live/ in the output folder: a field plane as <stage>_sub-<id><affix>.f32 and .json, or, for the k-Wave MATLAB pressure field, its figure as .png. The Nexus shows these frames while the run is going. 0 1 = yes, 0 = no. Pressure frames need a k-Wave MATLAB solver (matlab_cpu, matlab_gpu, or the elastic model) BabelBrain with CUDA, or jwave; not the k-Wave C++ solvers. Slows the k-Wave solvers down; jwave Helmholtz then solves in chunks of GMRES restarts. debug Verbose debug mode with additional intermediate outputs. 0 1 = yes, 0 = no. Outputs go to debug/ and are listed in the debug report. debug_stages Stages that write debug outputs. all all, or a list of preproc, medium, source, babelbrain. debug_figures Write diagnostic figures (PNG). 1 1 = yes, 0 = no. 3D figures are saved from three angles. debug_volumes Write intermediate volumes (NIfTI). 1 Each is about the size of the head volume; 0 keeps only figures. transducer_coupling How several transducers interact acoustically. 'coherent' coherent: pressure fields superpose in one k-Wave run (interference). async: each transducer is simulated separately; safety metrics take the per-voxel maximum and heating follows each transducer's firing schedule. See Multi-Transducer Modelling. uncertainty_fov Grid of the uncertainty variants. 'config' 'config': all variants on the configured grid. 'partial' (experimental): the default on the whole grid, the four bound variants and a repeat of the default medium in the partial acoustic FOV (grid.acoustic_fov_*, else 'auto'); the report rescales the bound variants. See Partial-FOV Bound Variants. uncertainty_overrides Edited bound values of the uncertainty variants, per variant (temp_high, temp_low, trans_high, trans_low), tissue, and property. [] Merged onto the shipped ITRUSST bounds in config/uncertainty/; [] = bounds unchanged. Thermal properties of the Trans variants cannot be edited. See Customising Medium Property Ranges.

items.title: Simulation Backends (acoustic_backend, thermal_backend)
items.text:
Top-level keys (not nested under simulation). Pre-processing (segmentation, medium, grid, placement) and post-processing (analysis, NIfTI export, report) are shared by all backends. See Simulation backends for how the backends compare and when results are directly comparable.

Parameter Description Default Comments acoustic_backend Acoustic solver. 'kwave' kwave / kwave_elastic / babelbrain / jwave. Validated in load_parameters. babelbrain takes one transducer, with the beam along the grid z axis (not grid.mode: ras_plus); see BabelBrain geometry limits. kwave_elastic models shear waves in the skull (see Elastic skull). kwave_elastic, babelbrain, and jwave are experimental, not validated. thermal_backend Bio-heat solver. 'kwave' kwave / babelbrain (experimental). babelbrain requires acoustic_backend: babelbrain, one transducer, and no path.acoustic_input; invalid combinations error at config load. jwave has no thermal solver; pair it with kwave.

items.title: BabelBrain Settings (babelbrain)
items.text:
Used when acoustic_backend or thermal_backend is babelbrain, or when io.export_babelbrain: true. Full explanation in BabelBrain.

Parameter Description Default Comments python_env BabelBrain conda env (directory containing bin/python) or Python executable. '' Must be set; system python3 lacks BabelViscoFDTD. root BabelBrain source tree. '' Empty = external/BabelBrain submodule. computing_backend GPU/CPU backend. 'auto' auto / cuda / opencl / metal / cpu (or 1–4). auto: Metal on macOS, else CUDA if nvidia-smi finds a GPU, else CPU. The thermal engine has no CPU backend. device_name Device name. 'auto' Set explicitly when several GPUs are present. tx_system BabelBrain transducer preset. '' Empty = the PRESTUS transducer's ring geometry (as calibrated). A preset name uses BabelBrain's device definition. See Transducer mapping. ppw Points-per-wavelength floor for BabelBrain's own FDTD grid. 12 Lower = faster, more numerical dispersion. match_grid Build the PRESTUS grid at BabelBrain's own step. false true replaces grid.resolution_mm with BabelBrain's step (smallest sound speed, normally 1102.5 m/s, ÷ frequency ÷ ppw), so the head model is built once on BabelBrain's grid and not resampled. For comparisons with native BabelBrain runs; needs acoustic_backend: babelbrain. do_refocusing Apply BabelBrain's refocusing step. false Thermal then uses /p_amp_refocus. tight_narrow_beam BabelBrain's own lateral domain shrink. false Always off when grid.acoustic_fov_* is set. drive Element drive. 'prestus' prestus: BabelBrain reproduces the PRESTUS element phases, as the other backends. native: BabelBrain steers itself to focal_distance_ep, as a run from its own interface; for emulating such a run. focal_calibration Geometric-fallback steering calibration. true Locate-only when explicit element phases exist. focal_calibration_target Quantity placed at focal_distance_ep. 'flhm_center' flhm_center / peak profile_calibration Refit drive phases to the continuous-bowl ideal. false BabelBrain only; moves it away from the k-Wave/jwave phases. Leave off for cross-backend comparison. water_amp_calibration Scale output so its free-water ISPPA equals transducer.target_isppa_wcm2. true The free-water ISPPA comes from BabelBrain's own water-only run, so the scaling also removes BabelBrain's source amplitude bias. Skipped when no water run or target is available. use_rayleigh_for_water Water-only solver. false false = FDTD (like-for-like with k-Wave/jwave). q_correction Bone Q-factor correction (BabelBrain QCorrection) of the relaxation attenuation model. [] [] = 1.0 on the non-CT path (realises the specified bone alpha_coeff), BabelBrain's 3.0 on the CT path. Realised bone attenuation scales ~1/Q; values > 0 override both paths. shear Bone shear in BabelBrain. 'off' off: fluid bone (shear speed 0). prestus_elastic: cortical and trabecular bone get the shear speed, shear attenuation and longitudinal attenuation of kwave_elastic (elastic: section) at the drive frequency, for an elastic comparison with k-Wave. Label path only (not with ct_mapping). medium Medium BabelViscoFDTD runs on. 'labels' labels: BabelBrain's tissue labels with medium_properties. prestus: the PRESTUS acoustic medium as k-Wave sees it, including smoothed properties and a pseudo-CT skull, quantised into up to 1000 materials. Fluid; heating with thermal_backend: kwave; not with ct_mapping, shear: prestus_elastic, or q_correction. See PRESTUS medium. ct_mapping BabelBrain HU→property mapping. '' Empty = label mask with PRESTUS medium_properties. See CT-based skull properties. air_regions Internal air (sinuses, mastoid) as a pressure-release reflector mask. false Pseudo-CT path only (ct_mapping set); not applied to the free-water run. See Internal air. air_hu_window HU range classified as air for air_regions. [-1200, -400] BabelBrain's default. air_keep_boundary Keep air components touching the domain boundary. false By default they are removed with the exterior air (cropping can split it). ct_use_petra PETRA density formula for Webb-Marsac. false tx_mech_adjust_z_m Additional transducer standoff [m]. 0 Added to the automatic placement correction. z_steering_m Pin BabelBrain ZSteering [m]. ~ Empty = auto-derived. isppa_w_per_cm2 Override the ISPPA given to BabelBrain thermal [W/cm²]. ~ Interpreted as the in-situ peak ISPPA in brain. Empty = derived from the scaled acoustic field (recommended; matches k-Wave thermal). cleanup_cache Delete the per-subject BabelBrain cache after reading. true Result HDF5s are moved out first. dry_run Prepare the BabelBrain inputs without simulating. false The pipeline stops after the acoustic stage; nothing is cached.

items.title: jwave Settings (jwave)
items.text:
Used when acoustic_backend: jwave.

PML thickness is set by grid.pml_size. See jwave for the solvers and the PML size.

Parameter Description Default Comments python_env Python environment or executable with jwave. '' Its root, its bin directory, or the Python executable. Empty = system python3. python_env_gpu GPU-capable (CUDA) Python environment. '' Its root, its bin directory, or the Python executable. Empty = same as python_env. use_gpu Use GPU acceleration. ~ ~: auto-detect via nvidia-smi; true: GPU environment (errors if python_env_gpu is unset); false: CPU environment. solver jwave solver. 'helmholtz' helmholtz (frequency-domain GMRES) / pseudo_spectral (time-domain, as kspaceFirstOrder*) / finite_differences (time-domain, FD stencils). fd_accuracy FD stencil order. 8 finite_differences only. gmres_restart GMRES restart parameter (Krylov subspace size). 10 jwave's default; larger values can destabilise GMRES in single precision. Helmholtz solver only. gmres_maxiter Maximum GMRES iterations. 1000 jwave's default. Helmholtz solver only. gmres_tol GMRES convergence tolerance. 1.0e-3 jwave's default. Helmholtz solver only. convergence_threshold Relative Helmholtz residual above which the run errors. 0.05 See ignore_convergence_threshold. ignore_convergence_threshold Warn instead of erroring above convergence_threshold. false The unconverged result is then returned. helmholtz_operator Density term of the Helmholtz solver. 'conservative' conservative: ρ∇·((1/ρ)∇p), source scaled by the local sound speed. jwave: jwave's built-in term, which underestimates transmission through density jumps (~20 % through a skull plate). See jwave: density term. dry_run Write the HDF5 solver inputs only. false The pipeline stops after the acoustic stage (no analysis, thermal, or report) and caches nothing. Use it to inspect the grid before running. cleanup_cache Delete the HDF5 solver input after a successful run. true *_jwave_input*.h5 in io.dir_cache, several GB for a head grid. It is rewritten on every run and never reused. Kept on dry runs and failed runs (e.g. Helmholtz residual above threshold); set false to keep it for debugging.

items.title: Elastic Skull Settings (elastic)
items.text:
Used when acoustic_backend: kwave_elastic.

Applied to the skull layers (skull, skull_cortical, skull_trabecular). Attenuations are power laws a·f^y [dB/(cm·MHz^y)], converted to the solver's y = 2 law so the value at the source frequency is exact. Sources and rationale: k-Wave elastic backend.

Parameter Description Default Comments shear_mapping Skull shear speed mapping. 'pichardo' pichardo: cS = a(f0)·ρ + b(f0), Pichardo et al. 2017 fits (a = 0.458, b = 545.52 at 270 kHz; a = 0.386, b = 815.51 at 836 kHz), interpolated linearly to the transducer frequency, extrapolated with a warning outside that range. Uses the density map (pseudo-CT or layer densities). off: cS = 0 (fluid skull through the elastic solver). shear_density_min No shear support at or below this density [kg/m³]. 1200 poisson_min Minimum Poisson ratio; caps cS at cL·√((1−2ν)/(2(1−ν))). 0.1 Bone: ν ≈ 0.2–0.35. alpha_coeff_shear Shear attenuation [dB/(cm·MHz^y)]. 43.63 Power law through Pichardo et al. 2017 (57 Np/m at 270 kHz, 373 Np/m at 836 kHz). alpha_power_shear Shear attenuation exponent y. 1.662 alpha_coeff_long Skull longitudinal attenuation in elastic runs [dB/(cm·MHz^y)]. 27.31 Power law through the values Pichardo et al. 2017 paired with their shear fit (33 Np/m at 270 kHz, 231 Np/m at 836 kHz). Used with long_attenuation: elastic. alpha_power_long Longitudinal attenuation exponent y. 1.722 long_attenuation Source of skull longitudinal attenuation. 'elastic' elastic: alpha_coeff_long. medium: keep the fluid/pCT skull alpha_coeff (effective values that already include shear losses). min_ppw_shear Warn below this many points per shear wavelength. 6

items.title: Sonication Timing (timing)
items.text:
See Thermal Simulations.

Protocol duration fields must be set for thermal simulations.

Parameter Description Default Comments pd Pulse Duration (PD) [s]. 0 Duty cycle = pd/pri. pri Pulse Repetition Interval (PRI) [s]. 0 PRF = 1/pri. ptd Pulse Train Duration (PTD) [s]. 0 pt_timestep Modelling time step within a pulse train [s]; used with equal_step_duration: 1. 0.02 ptri Pulse Train Repetition Interval (PTRI) [s]. 0 OFF duration = ptri − ptd. ptrd Pulse Train Repetition Duration (PTRD) [s]. 0 post_ptri_dur Steady-state period after the PTRD [s]. 0 post_pt_timestep Modelling time step between pulse trains and after the PTRD [s]. 1 equal_step_duration Equal step durations for on and off cycles? 0 1 = yes, 0 = no pulse_ramp_dur Rise (= fall) duration of the amplitude ramp at each end of a pulse [s]. (not set) = 0 Not in config_default.yaml. Scales the pulse-average intensity (Ipa = factor × Itp, compute_ramp_factor), the heat of every pulse in the thermal simulation, and the emitted power behind TIC by the same factor. Needs 2 × pulse_ramp_dur ≤ pd. pulse_ramp_shape Ramp shape: 'linear' or 'tukey' (raised cosine). (not set) = 'linear' Used with pulse_ramp_dur. async_schedule Async coupling (simulation.transducer_coupling: async): when each transducer fires. 'pulses' pulses: transducers take turns within each PRI (needs N × PD ≤ PRI). trains: within each PTRI (needs N × PTD ≤ PTRI). custom: per-transducer timing_offset_s and timing. See Firing Schedule. overlap_phase Async pulses at one frequency that partly overlap interfere while both are on: their relative carrier phase. 'clock' clock: the channels share one clock, so the simulated drive phases hold in every pulse. burst: each pulse starts its carrier at its own onset, so the phase also shifts by 2π·f·delay. See Firing Schedule.

The Nexus draws this protocol (pulse, pulse train, repetitions) and exchanges it with the TUS calculator; see Nexus.

items.title: Thermal Settings (thermal)
items.text:
See Thermal Simulations.

Parameter Description Default Comments cem43_iso CEM43 form used in the HTML report (dashboard, safety verdict, methods text): ISO 14708-3 / ITRUSST (1) or k-Wave kWaveDiffusion (0). 0 Both forms are always computed and written to CSV, NIfTI and figures. With thermal_backend: babelbrain it is set to 0 with a warning (prestus:cem43IsoBabelBrain): BabelBrain does not compute the ISO form. temp_0.{tissue} Initial temperature per tissue compartment [°C]. 37 Tissues: water, skull, brain, skin, skull_trabecular, skull_cortical pulse_model How pulses enter the heating simulation. 'train_averaged' 'train_averaged': each pulse train is one segment with the heat source weighted by PD/PRI, as k-Plan; 'pulse_resolved': every pulse and gap is a segment. Interleaved async schedules always resolve the pulses. See Pulse Model. log_thermal_updates Show k-Wave's thermal output for every time step. 0 0: only the first step is shown in full. max_focal_plane_gb Memory for the focal-plane time courses and the heating video [GB]. Above it, every k-th step is kept. 2 0: keep every step. The maximum and end maps and the per-tissue time courses always use every step.

items.title: Output Analysis (analysis)
items.text: Parameter Description Default Comments focus_area_radius Half-width of the cube around the focus in which Ipa is averaged for outputs [mm]. 5 target_mni_mm Intended target [x y z] in MNI mm for the targeting analysis. [] [] = the MNI target of the placement mode (placement.heuristic/plantus.mni_target_mm, placement.mni.focus_pos_mm), if any. Can differ per run (study manifest column). target_roi_mni Target ROI mask in MNI space (NIfTI) for the targeting analysis and the group maps. '' Overlap with the −3 dB focal volume, ROI coverage, intensity in the ROI; outlined on the group overlap figures.

items.title: Transducer Parameters
items.text:
These parameters define the transducer (from the equipment library or by hand), its drive, and its steering. The calibration fits read their own config: Calibration Parameters.

On this page:

  • Transducer Specification (transducer): ISPPA target, transducer type, frequency, library entry, and positions.

items.title: Transducer Specification (transducer)
items.text:
See Transducer Definition.

Except target_isppa_wcm2 (default 30), the fields have no defaults and must be set in the study config or come from the equipment library (serial).

Parameter Description Comments target_isppa_wcm2 Target free-water ISPPA [W/cm²] of this transducer alone. Default 30. Scalar: the field is scaled to it (needs a free-water baseline; see modules.run_water_baseline). Vector: one thermal job per value (multi-intensity). Empty []: no scaling, the field is reported at elem_p_amp. Several transducers: each transducer's own target; coherent runs set each drive before the simulation, async runs scale each field before combining (see Multi-transducer: ISPPA targets). type Type of transducer array. annular / matrix. Mandatory. freq_hz Fundamental frequency [Hz]. Shared across all elements. serial Equipment serial; geometry, phases, and drive come from the equipment config and transducer library. See Transducer Library. Values set in the study config take precedence. combo.ds_serial Driving-system serial. Selects the calibration entry for <serial> with this driving system; without it only the driving-system-agnostic entry is looked up. library_path Folder with your own library entries. Calibration entries there are used when one exists for this combo, otherwise the shipped config/calibration/ (with a warning). Equipment entries there (*_transducer.yaml, *_driver.yaml) add transducers or replace shipped ones. See Your own transducers and calibrations. max_elem_p_amp Largest drive your driving system delivers [Pa, as elem_p_amp]. Empty = the drive_limit of the combo in the equipment entry, if any. A library drive above it warns (resolve_transducer_from_serial:driveLimit) with the largest ISPPA reachable at that depth. See Drive limits. condition Experimental, not validated. Dephased library condition (conditions.<label> in the library entry). Replaces the focal-depth lookup; focal_distance_ep defaults to the condition's nominal setpoint. See Dephased conditions. timing_offset_s Async custom schedule: delay of this transducer's first pulse [s]. Empty = 0. See Firing Schedule. timing.pd, timing.pri, timing.ptd, timing.ptri, timing.ptrd Async custom schedule: this transducer's pulse and train timing and its sonication duration [s], replacing the timing block's. Empty = the timing block's. Read only by custom; with another schedule they are an error. trans_pos Transducer position (XYZ, bowl apex). T1 voxels by default; RAS+ or MNI mm via placement.manual.coordinate_space. focus_pos Focus (target) position (XYZ). T1 voxels by default; RAS+ or MNI mm via placement.manual.coordinate_space. focal_distance_ep Focal depth setting: the depth the device is set to focus at, from the exit plane [mm]. For annular arrays it selects the library phases and drive, so the simulated focus lands here whatever the trans_pos→focus_pos distance (the planned target depth). Empty = that distance minus focal_distance_offset (focal_distance_calculation). focal_distance_bowl Focal depth setting from the bowl apex [mm]. focal_distance_ep + bowl-to-exit-plane offset; set either. focal_distance_offset Offset between transducer bowl and exit plane [mm]. Derived from curv_radius_mm − dist_geom_ep_mm. Not set by user.

items.title: Annular Array Definition (annular)
items.text: Parameter Description Comments elem_p_amp Pressure amplitude [Pa]; scalar or one value per element. Advanced: from calibration. Empty with a target ISPPA: a nominal drive scaled to it. elem_amp is the deprecated name (renamed on load with a warning). elem_phase_deg Source phase per element [degrees]. Advanced: from calibration. Empty: steered to focal_distance_ep (geometric phases for custom geometry). elem_n Number of transducer elements. elem_id_mm Inner diameter of each element [mm]. elem_od_mm Outer diameter of each element [mm]. curv_radius_mm Radius of curvature of the transducer bowl [mm]. Inf (YAML .inf) = flat element, e.g. a plane piston: its face at trans_pos is the exit plane; needs grid.use_kWaveArray: 1, in 3D a single disc. See Flat elements. dist_geom_ep_mm Distance from geometric focus to transducer plane [mm]. If not provided, the exit plane is the bowl rim: √(curv_radius_mm² − (max(elem_od_mm)/2)²) (Inf for flat elements). depth_mm Transducer depth [mm]. Visualization only.

items.title: Matrix Array Definition (matrix)
items.text: Parameter Description Comments elem_p_amp Pressure amplitude [Pa]; scalar or one value per element. Advanced: from calibration. Empty with a target ISPPA: a nominal drive scaled to it. elem_amp is the deprecated name (renamed on load with a warning). depth_mm Transducer depth [mm]. Visualization only. steering Steering mode of the transducer. 1D = axial only, 3D = volumetric steering. elem_shape Shape of individual elements. Options: rect, disc, bowl. Element area is defined using the rectangular dimensions and projected onto the selected shape, unless elem_diameter_mm is set. elem_height_mm Element height [mm], along y. rect elements: size along y; disc/bowl: sets the equal-area diameter. elem_width_mm Element width [mm], along x. rect elements: size along x; disc/bowl: sets the equal-area diameter. elem_diameter_mm Aperture diameter of disc/bowl elements [mm]. Optional. Empty = equal-area diameter from elem_width_mm × elem_height_mm (flat disc area for disc, spherical-cap area for bowl). Also sets the element size in the transducer mask. elem_phase_override_deg Calibrated per-element phases [deg]. Optional, one value per element (after Clover replication). Replaces the geometric steering phases toward focus_pos; element orientation is unchanged. Empty = geometric steering. use_steering_correction Experimental, not validated. Scale the element drive by the steering correction k(target). Default true. Used when the transducer library (or steering_correction) holds one; see Steering correction of matrix arrays. steering_correction Steering correction given inline. Optional struct as written by build_steering_correction. Empty = from the transducer library. outer_diameter_mm Outer diameter of the transducer [mm]. Defines active aperture boundary. is_curved Whether the array has a curved surface. false = flat array: every element faces +z, curv_radius_mm is not used, elem_shape must be rect or disc. curv_radius_mm Radius of curvature (ROC) of the transducer bowl [mm]. Defines natural focus. Depends on is_curved. dist_geom_ep_mm Distance from geometric focus to transducer plane [mm]. If not provided, the exit plane is the bowl rim: √(curv_radius_mm² − (outer_diameter_mm/2)²). Depends on is_curved. is_clover_setup Enables Clover (multi-array) configuration. Replicates array into multiple leaves. matrix_shape.type Method used to define element positions. Options: define_here, extract_from_file.

items.title: Matrix: Clover (clover)
items.text: Parameter Description Comments n_leaves Number of Clover leaves. Any positive integer; one leaf stays on the parent axis unless elevation_deg is set. ROC_parent Radius of curvature of the combined Clover setup [mm]. Can differ from individual array ROC; elements then point at their own leaf's natural focus. az_sep_deg Azimuthal separation between adjacent leaves [deg]. Optional. Empty = 360 / n_leaves. n_leaves × az_sep_deg must not exceed 360. elevation_deg Tilt of each leaf from the parent axis [deg]. Optional. Empty = smallest tilt at which adjacent leaf centres are one outer_diameter_mm apart on the parent bowl.

items.title: Matrix: Grid Distribution (define_here)
items.text:
Warning: The define_here options are experimental and may contain bugs due to limited testing time.

Parameter Description Comments grid_shape.type Grid distribution type. Options: rect, fibonacci, fermat.

Rectangular Grid

Parameter Description Comments elem_n_row Number of element rows (along y). Row pitch: elem_height_mm + elem_spacing_height_mm. elem_n_col Number of element columns (along x). Column pitch: elem_width_mm + elem_spacing_width_mm. Elements whose centre lies outside outer_diameter_mm are dropped. elem_spacing_height_mm Spacing between elements in height direction [mm]. Edge-to-edge spacing. elem_spacing_width_mm Spacing between elements in width direction [mm]. Edge-to-edge spacing. sparsity_factor Fraction of active elements. Range: 0.1–1.0. Validated but not applied yet: all elements in the grid are used.

Fibonacci Grid

Parameter Description Comments elem_n Total number of elements. kerf_mm Minimum spacing between elements [mm].

Fermat Grid

Parameter Description Comments elem_n Total number of elements. Uses spiral distribution.

items.title: Matrix: File Extraction (extract_from_file)
items.text: Parameter Description Comments file_path Path to coordinate file. Must contain (x, y, z) [mm]. Curved array: origin at the centre of curvature, z towards the array. Flat array: origin at the array centre, z along the beam. start_row Row index where data starts. MATLAB may skip header row. start_col Column index where data starts. rot_col Column with each element's rotation about its own normal [deg]. Optional. For rectangular elements laid out in different orientations (e.g. 90 = turned on its side). Empty = all elements as elem_width_mm × elem_height_mm along x × y. elem_n Number of elements to extract. Can exceed final active count. select_random_subset Enable random subset selection. Useful for sparse arrays. subset.random_seed Controls reproducibility of subset. false or empty = the same subset every run; true = a new subset each run, with its seed printed in the log. subset.subset_n_elements Number of elements in subset. Must be ≤ total elements. project_on_new_ROC Project elements onto new curvature. May introduce unrealistic layouts. ROC_projection.new_ROC_mm New radius of curvature [mm]. Used when projection enabled.

items.title: Partial FOV
items.text:
A full acoustic simulation on a whole-head grid is slow and memory-intensive when only the focal zone and near field matter. The acoustic FOV crops the acoustic domain (k-Wave, BabelBrain or jwave) to a beam-axis-aligned box before the simulation and back-projects the result onto the full grid afterwards. A box that misses part of the beam or the focus gives a wrong field, so its size has to enclose both.

On this page:

  • Quick Start: the two keys that switch the FOV on.
  • FOV Box Geometry: where the box starts and how auto sizes it.
  • Choosing FOV Dimensions: what too small and too large boxes do, with starting values.
  • Thermal Grid: why the thermal simulation keeps the full grid by default.
  • Multi-Transducer Setups: FOV boxes for coherent, async, and independent runs.

At a glance

  • When you need it: Optional: for large grids, fine resolutions, or many runs.
  • Before you start: A working head simulation to compare against.

items.title: Quick Start
items.text:
Add the following keys to your study YAML (or set them on the parameters struct before calling prestus_pipeline_start):

grid:
  acoustic_fov_diameter_mm: 60   # lateral width [mm], centred on the focus
  acoustic_fov_length_mm:  120   # axial depth [mm], starting at the transducer

Choose values that enclose the focal zone and any near-field region of interest. The pipeline prints the resulting sub-grid dimensions and offset at runtime, so you can check the crop before a full run.

items.title: FOV Box Geometry
items.text:
The FOV is a rectangular box in the beam-axis-aligned acoustic grid:

Dimension Extent Anchor Axial (beam axis, z in transducer_axis mode) acoustic_fov_length_mm starts 8 voxels behind the bowl apex (trans_pos) Lateral (x, y) acoustic_fov_diameter_mm (full width) centred on the focal point

The axial start sits 8 voxels behind the bowl apex, which keeps the source points spread behind it, rather than at the focus, so the whole near field between transducer and focus is captured; this matters for skull heating metrics. The axial end should extend at least a few wavelengths beyond the focus to avoid boundary artefacts from the PML. acoustic_fov_length_mm: 'auto' sets the length to the apex-to-focus distance (trans_pos to focus_pos) plus grid.z_beyond_focus_mm (default 40 mm); acoustic_fov_diameter_mm: 'auto' uses the outer element diameter of transducer(1) plus a margin of 4 grid voxels per side, which holds the source points spread beyond the bowl rim. A numeric diameter smaller than that would crop the source; it is enlarged with a warning. The box is clamped to the full acoustic grid. If acoustic_fov_length_mm is too short for the focus to fall inside, a warning is raised; increase acoustic_fov_length_mm.

items.title: Choosing FOV Dimensions
items.text:
Parameter Too small Too large acoustic_fov_length_mm Focus outside FOV: warning, clamped focal position, incorrect simulation No harm; wastes grid voxels acoustic_fov_diameter_mm Lateral beam clipped, boundary reflections near focus No harm; wastes grid voxels

Recommended starting values for a single-element transducer at a ~70 mm depth:

acoustic_fov_diameter_mm: 60    # 3–4× the −6 dB beam diameter at focus
acoustic_fov_length_mm:  120    # bowl apex–focus distance + 40 mm (grid.z_beyond_focus_mm default)

At 2 mm resolution this box is roughly 30 × 30 × 60 voxels (54 k), compared with a whole-head grid of 256 × 216 × 192 mm (128 × 108 × 96 voxels, 1.3 M): a ~96 % reduction in voxel count. Print the actual reduction at runtime:

fprintf('FOV: [%s]  full: [%s]  reduction: %.1f %%\n', ...
    num2str(parameters.grid.dims), num2str(full_ac_dims), ...
    100*(1 - prod(parameters.grid.dims)/prod(full_ac_dims)));

items.title: Thermal Grid
items.text: Thermal conduction has a much longer spatial scale than the acoustic focal zone. Heat deposited at the focus diffuses into surrounding tissue over the sonication duration. Cropping the thermal domain would suppress heat loss to surrounding tissue (overestimating the peak temperature rise), miss heating of non-target structures just outside the FOV (such as the skull surface), and give incorrect boundary conditions at the crop edges. By default (grid.thermal_use_acoustic_fov: 0) the thermal stage therefore restores the full grid and back-projects the acoustic field onto it. With grid.thermal_use_acoustic_fov: 1, the thermal simulation runs inside the acoustic FOV box instead; this is faster, but the cooling boundary is less accurate. For faster thermal simulations, use grid.thermal_resolution_mm (coarser grid) or grid.thermal_fov_mm (explicit thermal crop, for prototyping only; see the caveat in PRESTUS Parameters).

items.title: Multi-Transducer Setups
items.text:
The FOV works in both multi-transducer couplings (Partial Acoustic FOV):

  • Coherent (all transducers in one run): the FOV box is the union of one box per transducer, each around that transducer's own beam axis, and every transducer's position is moved into the FOV grid. 'auto' is resolved per transducer.
  • Async (transducer_coupling: async): each transducer's acoustic run has its own FOV box; combine_async_intensity back-projects each field onto its full grid before combining, in shared and per_transducer grid mode.

Coherent fields can also be built from per-transducer partial-FOV runs by adding their complex fields (io.save_p_complex, superpose_complex_fields); the sum is complete only where the FOV boxes overlap.

For independent partial-FOV acoustic runs outside async mode, combine them with assemble_limited_fov_fields before thermal:

assemble_limited_fov_fields( ...
    {'sub-001_layered_results_t1.mat', 'sub-001_layered_results_t2.mat'}, ...
    'sub-001_layered_results_combined.mat', ...
    [target_t1_wcm2, target_t2_wcm2]);

The assembler back-projects each sub-grid onto the shared full acoustic grid, sums the intensities incoherently, and writes a combined cache that the thermal pipeline reads as a normal full-grid result. See Multi-Transducer Modelling for the full multi-transducer workflow.

Pipeline stages, cache, and functions Stage Effect Medium setup Full-grid state is saved before the crop. FOV crop acoustic_grid_fov crops kwave_medium, medium_masks, segmentation, trans_pos, focus_pos, and parameters.grid.dims to the sub-grid. Source/sensor setup kgrid and the source matrix are built on the sub-grid. Acoustic simulation k-Wave runs on the sub-grid; sensor_data.p_max_all is sub-grid sized. Acoustic analysis and NIfTI export Analysis runs on the sub-grid; outputs are back-projected to the full grid before NIfTI writing, so the spatial location is correct. Thermal setup Full-grid state is restored. sensor_data.p_max_all is back-projected to the full grid via fov_backproject_volume. kgrid is rebuilt from the full-grid parameters via thermal_grid_setup. With grid.thermal_use_acoustic_fov: 1, the FOV sub-grid is kept and only the T1 ↔ grid affines are shifted by the crop offset. Thermal simulation and analysis (Stages 8–9) Runs on the full grid, or on the FOV sub-grid with grid.thermal_use_acoustic_fov: 1.

The acoustic cache (.mat file) stores the sub-grid pressure field together with the crop metadata (acoustic_provenance.fov_offset_ac and acoustic_provenance.full_ac_dims). This keeps the cache small and lets assemble_limited_fov_fields back-project and combine multiple partial-FOV results from independent transducer placements.

Function Role acoustic_grid_fov Crops medium, masks, and positions to the FOV sub-grid; returns the crop offset. fov_backproject_volume Zero-pads a FOV-sized array back to a given full-grid size. assemble_limited_fov_fields Back-projects and incoherently combines N partial-FOV acoustic caches for multi-transducer thermal simulation. thermal_grid_setup Rebuilds kgrid and resamples medium/masks for the thermal stage, on the full acoustic grid or, with grid.thermal_use_acoustic_fov: 1, on the FOV sub-grid.
